# Weegloo Documentation

This file lists the documentation pages. Each link points to the clean Markdown source of that page (the `.md` suffix), suitable for direct reading by agents.

The `.md` paths are locale-independent: use each path exactly as listed, with no locale prefix (e.g. `/getting-started/….md`, never `/en-US/getting-started/….md`). A single `.md` source serves every locale.
